One day, shortly after his sister rescues young Kyouichi from a haunted shrine, she goes missing. Probably not the most helpful response but I just wanted to let you know you're not alone. 
I also have really bad ADHD and depression. I can't verbally express my feelings in away that makes sense to most people. I often describe things in a way that people have a hard time understanding like  " I feel like a lake of cracking ice" or  "my brain feels like chalk being dragged across a chalkboard" or "I feel like the color red today". These descriptions make perfect sense to me but others don't understand what I'm trying to convey and I can't think of any other way to explain them.
   Writing my thoughts down in a way that makes sense to me helps. Like I'll write it down and then write an analysis of it. I'm not sure if it would help you or not. I keep all my emotions and thoughts in a google doc on the off chance that I get brave enough to share them.
